name: the-alert-is-told-which-alert-it-is-showing
breaks: the window's alert goes back to being presented from a Bool alone, which carries no identity, so when the refusal to open the events displaces the code folder warning at launch nothing tells SwiftUI the content changed and the previous alert's buttons can stay on screen under the new one's title (#855). The whole block is perturbed rather than the presenting: line alone because removing that line by itself does not compile, and a compile error is not a verdict on the guard
